_recipe.title: App demo
_recipe.when: Show an app or SaaS doing its main job in under 30s: the input, the result, the extras, the download. Works for mobile apps, web tools and AI assistants.
beats: Hook: the job and how few steps it takes, on screen at frame 0.
Demo 1: a real input typed into the app; cursor clicks; the result appears.
Demo 2: ask the assistant / support a real question, show the real answer.
Extras: three more things it does, as checks.
Proof: store rating or user count that counts up.
CTA: a big download button (overrides the theme's quiet link), store + handle.
copyTips: The demo prompt and reply must be real app output; copy them from the app, don't invent them.
Keep the typed prompt under ~80 characters so the typing never drags.
Studio-dark looks like a modern app UI at night. Light UI apps: --theme clean. Developer tools: --theme neon.
Rating or downloads only if the user gives the number and source ("4.8 on the App Store").
The CTA kicker carries price and platforms ("Free on iOS & Android", "₹199/month on web"); the button stays two words.
